notes.title: Paintball 707 Update to v2.0.033
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27021833/f5fc7d04e6a6b07efbb14c03b764301cb146cce4.jpg
New AI
The code for the bots was completely rewritten because the old AI left much to be desired.
In short, the new AI code is only 20% of the old code, but has much more features. The bots and the performance have become noticeably better!
Also the bots have got new animations.

All changes in this update:

Changelog
=========
--------------------------------------------------
v.2.0.033 | June 27, 2018

	General
	- performance improvements

	Maps
	- new map: Dust
	
	AI
	- completely new AI code for bots
	- new animations added
	- select from 4 different AI levels on map start
	- pathfinding improvements
	- added footstep sounds

--------------------------------------------------

notes.title: Paintball 707 Online-COOP, new maps, improved AI
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27021833/92ebc26aa97ec0e581201452ef8f36d135464382.png
Multiplayer COOP
The new update 
The new update will make some important changes to the game. In multiplayer it's now possible to play against bots and so the waiting time -until other players connect- gets shorten and more interesting.
Tha admin will have the possibility to kick the bots of a team and to start a match ' player team against bot team ' !
Of course, the admin can also kick all bots.

AI Improvements
Overall, the AI has been significantly improved and it's no longer as easy as in older versions to win a match. The bots are much more aggressive, more accurate and noticeably more actively taking flags.

Minimap
To improve the orientation, a MINIMAP has been added to each map. By pressing the 'M' button it can be enabled/disabled. With 'B' and 'N' buttons, the map can be enlarged/zoomed out.

2 new maps
As an addition there are two brand new maps:

Castle
A castle has to be stormed or defended.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27021833/b035152e1aef6ee79a8deeedc570dae524c8d835.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27021833/e78253011444a0d2733cb57155662701330a369a.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27021833/5437480d8e018025f5dfb8299857c6c31e24c38e.jpg


Hardcore
A paintball hall with good coverage.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27021833/3792f3b9c00815ec4ab298215996e4b49666ddac.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27021833/50bd0d7c9e6b34cae7843936e04d7d473e0380f5.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27021833/2cadb48931a8d6cee4f732485153b193522e5dbd.jpg


Changelog
[code]
General
	- several performance improvements
	- controls: keys 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,0
	  to select player weapons directly
	- added MiniMap system
	- added pictures to weapon selection
	- new gimmick soapbubbles added
	
	MENU
	- removed the screenshot delete 
	  button for security reasons

	MAPS
	- new map: Castle
	- new map: Hardcore
	- Abandoned Building: base flags
	  can now be captured (SP only)


	WEAPONS
	- M-16 decreased aim-error-angle
	- Mac-10 aiming position changed
	- Victor2 changed to autofire
	- new sounds for...
	  - M-1928
	  - Victor2
	  - XVC-1
	  - Mosin Sniper

	SINGLEPLAYER
	- fixed a bug when player gets kicked
	  into the air while colliding with bots
	- improved AI
	  - improved pathfinding
	  - bots now primary try to capture
	    neutral flags
	  - slowed down bots run animation

	MULTIPLAYER
	- AI COOP mode added
	  - bots of each team or all bots can
	    be kicked by admin
	  - kick just the bots of one team and 
	    play humans vs bots
[/code]

notes.title: Patch v2.0.019 available
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27021833/17416397afbf68255b2e66240859ff07fd346402.png
An updated version is available now and most of the suggestions of the community could be implemented. Learn more in the Changelog below.

The update also includes a new scene called 'Abandoned Building' and a new sniper marker.

To get some more life into multiplayer there are 2 important things that have been added to the lobby:
A voice announces if someone else created a room so you can run the game in background and wait for other players.
In addition a date for the next multiplayer event for your region is displayed in the lobby, so it's much easier to find other people online on a fix date.

I hope you like the improvements and wish you a merry christmas everyone!

[code]
	General
	- new scene 'Abandoned Building'
	- added Mosin sniper weapon
	- fixed aim-position for some weapons
	- improved MAC-10 aimimg
	- decreased jump height
	- fixed bullets destroy after impact
	- fixed resolution selection in menu

	Singleplayer
	- Bots are marked now with just 1 hit

	Multiplayer
	- In lobby the next international event is displayed
	- In lobby a voice announces new created rooms
	- Conquest games automatically run through a mapcycle now
	- enable/disable gimmicks for a MP room
	- all weapons available for selection
	- fixed weapon alignment for XVC-1
[/code]
